fieldValues.fieldValue: Booked via OPD voice PA agent.

parameters.content:
## OPD Voice Appointment Automation v2

Three authenticated endpoints for ElevenLabs PA tools (header auth: "OPD Webhook Auth"):
- POST /opd/route-call  -> emergency triage + department routing
- POST /opd/check-slots -> live availability from Supabase (future, untaken)
- POST /opd/book-appointment -> validated booking

Race-safety: opd_appointments has UNIQUE(doctor_id, slot_start). A double-book makes the Insert Appointment node throw; its ERROR output is the "slot taken" branch. The DB is the lock.

SMS: verbal-only for now (sms_status = verbal_confirmed). Add a real SMS node after Confirm Booking once an SMS provider credential is connected.

Emergency number 1122 (Rescue Pakistan) - confirm before go-live.
